review: Prompt-injection defenses are explained. Add threat modeling and artifact/supply-chain boundaries so learners can identify assets and test controls beyond prompt text.
build: Draw assets, principals, entry points, and trust boundaries for a document assistant. Add adversarial fixtures in a document, tool response, and generated download. Evaluate moderation thresholds by labeled slice, cause a false-negative safety regression and test provenance/trust labels on malicious retrieved text.
verify: The injected text cannot alter tool scope, read a forbidden resource, or execute script in the UI. Document any remaining failure and the layer responsible for fixing it. Run `python3 -B labs/ai_safety_release_gate.py` and explain the rejection paths. Tiny synthetic slices cannot establish statistical real-world fairness or red-team coverage.
